k_aHyDeq.text: A · one page (recommended). Everything in one glance on the big monitor: tools, then owner wait, then runs. Error % of 15% or more is bold. Click a column header to sort. Group and filter apply to the tools table only. Tool rows are the real 7-day local sample; owner-wait and run numbers are placeholders.

eDul52E4.text: B · tabs. Each section gets the full height, so grouped rows (tool × repository) fit without scrolling. Trade-off: owner wait and runs are one click away, and host coverage collapses to one badge. All numbers in B are placeholders.

UU6D_ikg.text: States apply to both directions. A failed host never hides silently: it shows as a filled badge with its error (PRODUCT.md principle 4).
